title: Compliance Manual — Set-up Notice Extension and the Consumer's Card History (Payment Arrangements)
content:
For a plan under Payment Arrangements that moves to a new payment method, a set-up notice extension applies according to the consumer's card history and the plan's payment-method history over the last twelve months.

## Clause

The set-up notice extension follows the consumer's card history and the plan's payment-method history over the last twelve months:

(a) when a debit card or credit card payment was posted on any of the consumer's placed accounts, no card payment on those accounts was returned and the plan recorded no payment-method change, the extension is 0 days;

(b) when a card payment on the consumer's placed accounts was returned or the plan recorded a payment-method change, the extension is 3 days;

(c) when no card payment was posted or returned and the plan recorded no payment-method change, the extension is 2 days.

The card payments posted and returned are read from the money history of the consumer's accounts under Placed Consumer Accounts — payment entries and returned payment entries whose channel is debit card or credit card, on every placed account the consumer owes. The payment-method changes are the payment-method change entries on this plan's installment history. Periods of twelve months are counted in whole months back from the handling date.

## Truth table

| Card payment posted (last 12 months) | Card payment returned (last 12 months) | Payment-method change on the plan (last 12 months) | Extension |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | No | 0 days |
| Yes or no | Yes | Yes or no | 3 days |
| Yes or no | Yes or no | Yes | 3 days |
| No | No | No | 2 days |

## Cases (hypothetical histories)

- A consumer paid a utility account by debit card four months ago, with no card return anywhere and no earlier payment-method change on this plan: 0 days.
- The same consumer, but this plan recorded a payment-method change seven months ago: 3 days.
- A consumer who has paid only by bank debit and check, with no payment-method change on this plan: 2 days.
- A credit card payment on another of the consumer's placed accounts was charged back ten months ago: 3 days, whatever else is on record.
